svg.title: Position error and filter bound on a transfer toward the Moon
svg.desc: An onboard nine-state filter on a transfer from low orbit toward the Moon, from a real run of engine v0.39.0 on scenarios/gnss-ssv-nav-lunar.toml (289 epochs, 13 points drawn). On a log axis, the true position error and the filter's own one-sigma bound against time since the start. Inside the GNSS orbits the position RMS is 1.4 m; above them it is 90 m, with the final error 184 m at 193,330 km altitude with 1 measurement. Mean normalised estimation error squared over the whole run is 4.4 (about 3 for a consistent position block). Truth and filter share their Sun and Moon stand-ins. MODELLED: a modelled study from stated inputs, not a measurement and not a service-volume claim for any system. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
